rationale: AC2 requires the env var to be absent per-invocation when automation_profile is unset; Option B's process-wide os.environ mutation cannot satisfy that, while Option A reuses the existing automation_profile per-call gating pattern.
rule: Option A: Thread disable_background_tasks bool param through build_streaming() call chain
alternatives_rejected: Option B: apply_disable_background_tasks_from_config() os.environ helper mirroring apply_host_cli_from_config() (Pattern B) — rejected because it leaks the disable into later interactive/non-automation invocations sharing the process.
